card.name: Visitor and pilgrim site descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, to, no, then, who, their) in the middle of a sentence about visitors or pilgrims at a cathedral, church, cave or other tourist site. It also fires on a few other sentences in the same descriptive style.

modes.label: Linking word after visitors
modes.description: A connecting word right after a clause about visitors or pilgrims doing something at a site.
modes.example: Located in New York City, Saint Patrick’s Cathedral hosts over 5.5 million people each year to visit<< and>> pray.

modes.label: Pilgrim actions
modes.description: A word in a chain of steps pilgrims take at a shrine.
modes.example: Pilgrims cross themselves upon entry to the chapel, kiss the painting, cross themselves again and<< then>> have one of the nuns anoint

modes.label: Access notes
modes.description: A word in a sentence about opening or access conditions of a site.

card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in travel-guide style text about pilgrims and visitors at religious or tourist sites.
